saved_dungeons_material_metadata.formula: max((sRGBDecode(auxiliary.rgb).b * Emissive * EmissivePower + sRGBDecode(albedo.rgb) * NaturalEmissive) * DeathEmissive, 0)

texture_srgb.provenance: SRGB is absent in both original texture packages; UE texture parser default is true

static_defaults.game_time_domain: time >= 0; no active runtime damage/enchantment/selection override

preview.surface_lighting: Blockbench studio light; not original scene lighting
preview.note: Only the static linear emissive equation is ported from DXBC. Preview tone mapping and scene light are explicitly separate.

saved_dungeons_material_metadata.preservation: Original albedo and auxiliary PNG bytes embedded unchanged; no emission baked into albedo; HDR parameters remain floating point.

original_uv_coverage.method: UV0 triangle-cell positive-area intersection, unioned per original quad so its diagonal is not counted as reuse; also reports texel-center sampling. Atlas clipped to [0,64]^2, no unverified wrap extrapolation.
original_uv_coverage.padding_caveat: Edge-connected opaque black is an operational padding-candidate class, not a proven material-use semantic. Never force every atlas pixel onto geometry.
original_uv_coverage.original_reuse_conclusion: Boot left/right sharing, repeated plant planes and source root-strip column reuse are explicit in original mesh UVs; no fabricated uniqueness requirement applied.

conditional_assembly_status: Conditional original-player-bind-pose assembly; not proof of native Paperdoll assignment or original reference image pose

assembly_evidence_completeness.omitted_engine_template_transform_fields: Resolved to zero location/rotation and unit scale using standard Engine component/socket defaults, individually flagged; not relabeled serialized observations.

geometry_acceptance: Source topology, UV0 and rigid binding retain exact data if their reported differences are zero. Nonzero numeric transform/Euler errors remain explicit; no global bitwise-zero claim.
native_limits: Original normals, tangents and UV1 are in verified sidecar, not consumed by native mesh import.

Both original Albedo/S texture bytes and source material metadata are stored. This file-only geometry audit does not certify effective rendered shader, bloom, exposure or lighting reproduction; material migration is a separate active task.
Serialized .props switch values do not establish effective shader permutation; effective switches must come from compiled native shader evidence.
Actual runtime bind deformation is not measured by this file-only audit; parent native runtime check is separate.
Assembly uses original player bind/socket evidence with explicit default assumptions; native GearActor Paperdoll assignment and original reference image pose remain unproved.
